competitions:
CREATE TABLE `competitions` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `libelle` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `lieu` varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `date` date NOT NULL,
  `comite` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `comments` text NOT NULL,
  `filepdf` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `filetxt` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `bassin` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `chrono` char(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  `ld` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `wid` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `equipe` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `reference` int(11) DEFAULT '0',
  `arrived` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `integration` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `type` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `organisateur` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `delegue` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `enddate` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `typecnc` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `derogation` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `affiche` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `live` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `qualiffrance` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `description` text NOT NULL,
  `integrationstatus` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `id` (`id`),
  KEY `livepalmes_date_id` (`date`,`id`)
) ENGINE=MyISAM AUTO_INCREMENT=0 DEFAULT CHARSET=latin1
compet_parametres:

  `sendpdfclubs` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `sendpdfjuges` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `sendforfait` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `qualif` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `who` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `officiel` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `saisie` int(11) DEFAULT '0',
  `relais` int(11) DEFAULT '0',
